ada.text: Good morning, everyone! I'm Ada, and I keep bees, so my morning errands began with a walk to the orchard to see how the blossoms are coming along for my hives. Then I strolled across the green toward the cottage bench, hoping for a quiet sit in the sun. The bees were busy and so was I, and it's lovely to be here with you all now.

bo.text: Um... hello. This morning I meant to wander the green and play my little tune alone. Then plans changed, and I was sent here to the pond hall instead. I was nervous about it, but it's nice to sit with all of you. Thank you for listening.
